overview_description.description: Letter AI offers a generative AI-powered revenue enablement platform that helps sales and enablement teams create, organize, and deliver content, training, coaching, and buyer engagement tools. Its platform uses company documents and data to generate personalized sales materials and simulations, provide real-time assistance through an AI co-pilot, and automate parts of the sales process such as RFP responses and deal rooms. The software supports interactive training, scalable coaching with roleplay scenarios, and contextual content personalization for specific audiences. Letter AI also includes features for managing and discovering relevant assets quickly and enabling more efficient revenue workflows. The platform emphasizes anchoring AI responses in a customer’s own knowledge base to reduce inaccuracies.
